entries.zh: 男子伟；伟男子，伟岸出众的男子汉
entries.en: man, male; an outstanding/virile man (Sp. varón)

entries.zh: 乾坤；天地，男妇（阴阳两性）
entries.en: man and woman; heaven and earth, the male and female principles

entries.zh: 变迁；世代轮转，岁月流变
entries.en: change, vicissitude through the ages; revolving/turning (as of a wheel)
entries.notes: H 栏第二字有疑（薺/辇），L 栏 Variedad en los sieios 疑为 en los siglos（岁月间的变化），释义仅得其概。

entries.en: fortified village, walled settlement; quarter/barrio of a town
entries.notes: M 栏 Po yao 残损（T99），第二读音字难辨；据 L 栏 barrio 与 H 栏堡释义。

entries.zh: 民；臣民，属民（臣服于主上者）
entries.en: vassal, subject (one owing service to a ruler)

entries.zh: 甲首户；里甲赋役编组中充任甲首（十户之长）的人户
entries.en: jia-shou household: household serving as head of a jia (ten-household unit) in the lijia fiscal-registration system

entries.zh: 百姓人；老百姓，平民大众
entries.notes: M 栏第二字（姓）声调号污损（T99）；字面百姓人仍据 H 栏自明。

entries.en: soldiers and civilians; military men and the people

entries.zh: 家民；贫苦之民（据稿内西语 pobre'贫穷'，疑为贫民）
entries.en: impoverished folk, the poor (per in-entry Spanish gloss pobre); lit. household people
entries.notes: M 栏读音 guie 与 H 栏家对音不合，稿内西语 pobre 提示贫民义，L 栏空白，语义未定从疑。

entries.zh: 器；器皿，容器（杯碗瓶罐之属）
entries.en: vessel, container; cup or jar (Sp. baso o vasija)
dish, plate; vessel of any metal

entries.zh: 器皿；金属器皿，杯盘器物
土粪；垃圾粪秽，污秽之物
entries.en: rubbish, refuse, filth; dirt and dung (Sp. basura)

entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（釗/剑），据 M 栏 guiam sio 与 L 栏 vaina（鞘）定为剑鞘。
